**[P2] Do not let read-retry exhaustion restart the deployment**

After this inner 10-attempt retry exhausts, it rethrows the 429 to the outer `retryOnConflict` around the entire deployment. A prolonged throttle while polling `$LATEST.PUBLISHED` will therefore rerun `updateFunction` and `PublishVersion`, duplicating phases this change intends to preserve and multiplying the retry duration substantially. Use one shared retry budget or convert an exhausted polling error so the outer loop cannot restart completed phases; add a test with more than ten consecutive post-publish throttles that still observes only one publish.
